result.topic_en: Solution of the heat-type equation $\partial\varsigma/\partial t+\varsigma-\partial^2\varsigma/\partial x^2=0$ by Fourier series with boundary conditions at $x=\pm a$, leading to theta-function expressions $\vartheta_1(v,q)$ and their transformation under $\log q\log q'=\pi^2$.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial\varsigma}{\partial t}+\varsigma-\frac{\partial^2\varsigma}{\partial x^2}=0\ ;\ \varsigma=e^{mx+\mu t}\ \ e^{mx+(m^2-1)t}$
$\mu+1-m^2=0\ ;\ \mu=m^2-1$
$\varsigma=\sum c_m e^{mxi-(m^2+1)t}$
$=\sum e^{-(m^2+1)t}(p_m\cos mx+q_m\sin mx)$
$u=\sum e^{-(m^2+1)t}\frac{(p_m\cos mx+q_m\sin mx)}{m^2}+A+Bx$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\sum e^{-(m^2+1)t}\frac{(-p_m\sin mx+q_m\cos mx)}{m}+B\ =0$ für $x=\pm a$
$=1$ für $t=0$
$p_m\sin ma=0\ \Big|\ p_m=0$ und $m=(n-\frac12)\frac{\pi}{a}\ \Big|\ B=0$
$q_m\cos ma=0\ \Big|\ q_m=0$ und $m=n\frac{\pi}{a}$
$u\frac{e^{-t}}{=}\sum e^{-(n-\frac12)^2\frac{\pi^2}{a^2}t}\, q_n\frac{\sin(n-\frac12)\frac{\pi x}{a}}{(n-\frac12)^2}+e^{-t}\sum e^{-\frac{n^2\pi^2}{a^2}t}p_n\frac{\cos\frac{n\pi x}{a}}{n^2}$

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\pi}{a}e^{-t}\Big\{\sum e^{-(n-\frac12)^2\frac{\pi^2 t}{a^2}}q_n\frac{\cos(n-\frac12)\frac{\pi x}{a}}{n-\frac12}\ [-+-]\sum e^{-\frac{n^2\pi^2 t}{a^2}}p_n\frac{\sin\frac{n\pi x}{a}}{n}$
$1=\frac{\pi}{a}\Big\{\sum q_n\frac{\cos(n-\frac12)\frac{\pi x}{a}}{n-\frac12}-p_n\frac{\sin\frac{n\pi x}{a}}{n}\Big\}$
$p_n=0\ ;\ \int_{-a}^{+a}\cos(\nu-\frac12)\frac{\pi x}{a}\,\partial x=\Big[\frac{\sin}{(\nu-\frac12)\frac{\pi}{a}}\Big]=\frac{2(-1)^{\nu-1}}{(\nu-\frac12)\frac{\pi}{a}}=\frac{\pi}{a}\sum\frac{q_n}{n-\frac12}\int_{-a}^{+a}\frac{\partial x}{2}\Big\{\cos(\nu+n-1)\frac{\pi x}{a}+\cos(\nu-n)\frac{\pi x}{a}\Big\}$
$=\frac{\pi}{a}\frac{q_\nu}{\nu-\frac12}\cdot a\ ;\ q_\nu=\frac{2(-1)^{\nu-1}}{\frac{\pi\pi}{a}}$
$\vartheta_1(v,q)=\sum(-1)^n q^{(n+\frac12)^2}e^{(2n+1)v}$
$q\frac{\partial\vartheta_1}{\partial q}=\sum(n+\frac12)^2(-1)^n q^{(n+\frac12)^2}e^{(2n+1)v}=\frac14\frac{\partial^2\vartheta_1}{\partial v^2}$
$\frac{-u_0}{u}=e^{-t}\cdot\frac{2a}{\pi\pi}\sum e^{-(n-\frac12)^2\frac{\pi^2 t}{a^2}}(-1)^{n-1}\frac{\sin(n-\frac12)\frac{\pi x}{a}}{(n-\frac12)^2}$
$\frac{\vartheta_1(v',q')}{\vartheta_1(v,q)}=e^{\alpha v^2+[-\ldots-]\beta}\ ;\ \log q\log q'=\pi^2\ ;\ v'=v\frac{\log q'}{\pi i}$
$\frac{-q'^{-1}e^{-2v'}}{-1}=e^{\alpha(2\pi i v-\pi^2)}\ \Big|\ \alpha\cdot 2\pi i=-2\frac{\log q'}{\pi i}\ ;\ \alpha=+\frac{\log q'}{\pi^2}=\frac{1}{\log q}$
$\Big|\ e^\beta=\frac{\log q'}{\pi i}\frac{\vartheta_1'(0,q')}{\vartheta_1'(0,q)}$
$q'^{[-\ldots-]}=e^{\alpha\pi^2}\ ;\ \vartheta_1(v',q')=e^{\beta}e^{\frac{v^2}{\log q}}\vartheta_1(v,q)$

$\varphi(\lambda)=\int_\lambda^\infty e^{-\lambda\lambda}d\lambda$
$\varsigma=e^{-t}\sigma\ ;\ \frac{\partial\varsigma}{\partial t}=e^{-t}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}-e^{-t}\sigma\ ;\ \frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}=\frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial x^2}$
$\sigma=f(\frac{x}{\sqrt t})\ ;\ \frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}=f'(-\frac12 x t^{-\frac32})$
$\frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial x^2}=f''\cdot\frac1t\ ;\ -\frac12\lambda f'=f''$
$-\frac14\lambda^2=\log f'\ ;\ f'=e^{-\frac14\lambda^2}$

methods.what: Fourier series solution with Neumann conditions at $x=\pm a$
Theta function $\vartheta_1$ satisfies the heat equation
Modular transformation of $\vartheta_1$ under $\log q\log q'=\pi^2$
Similarity solution of heat equation giving error function
